analyst.summary: Just Dial's core local-search business is mature and growing only modestly, and a large share of its reported profit actually comes from returns on its very large cash and investment holdings (roughly Rs.6,000 crore) rather than from the underlying advertising/listings operations -- worth knowing before crediting recent profit growth to the core business. The balance sheet is debt-free and conservatively run, with a new CEO and CFO just installed, but there is no clear catalyst yet for either the idle cash to be productively deployed or the core business to re-accelerate meaningfully.
